name: Saga AI
long_description: Saga deploys AI agents onto the back office of patient access for medical practices, physician groups, and health systems. The agents read every inbound referral, fax, and form, then complete the work inside the practice's EHR: they enter intake data, verify insurance eligibility with real-time X12 270/271 checks, submit and track prior authorizations through payer portals, and request missing records. Saga works in Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, MedENT, and other EHRs, with staff approval on sensitive actions. HIPAA-compliant, BAA included.
